response.original_title: Faces of Pain - L.H. Bararian & Fawn
response.overview: An experimental film about experiences of pain.  The film starts with a curiosity-driven investigation into facial expressions through pain. With an experimental point of view, the models are asked to think about the meaning of pain. The second half takes the viewer on a journey in which we immerse ourselves in the facial expressions, sounds and emotions arising from pain.
response.tagline: An experimental film about experiences of pain.
